column7: core half of login-storage-error-labelling-001 (#2745), and the guard against the fix becoming a NEW account-enumeration oracle: it asserts a storage error is reported as ErrLoginNotEvaluated, that no-such-user is NOT (it stays the bare "invalid credentials"), and that a wrong password for a REAL account produces the identical outcome to no-such-user. The second and third assertions are the load-bearing ones -- they pin the property the dummy-bcrypt spend exists for, so a later edit cannot quietly make account existence observable. Red-proven by mutation
